Package arztis.econnector.main.model

Class ConnectionData

java.lang.Object
arztis.econnector.main.model.ConnectionData
public class ConnectionData
extends java.lang.Object
This class includes all data, which are important for the Connections between AEC and an information system. Moreover it has the HCP assertion as attribute, because every Connection/User have their own assertion.

Anna
